title: HAProxy
comment: HAProxy has no runtime state to migrate -- the configuration file IS the application. The FreeBSD rc script reads haproxy_config (default /usr/local/etc/haproxy.conf), which rc_data_var picks up when the operator moved it; the official Linux image reads /usr/local/etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg; the Daemonless image runs -f /config/haproxy.conf. Certificate and socket paths inside the carried file name source locations and need editing before the proxy passes its config check -- the plan cannot rewrite them.
drop: TLS certificate files (paths inside the configuration need editing)
